title: World Liberty’s USD1 becomes Canton’s largest native stablecoin
message_html: World Liberty’s USD1 becomes Canton’s largest native stablecoin ...
snippet: World Liberty Financial (WLFI), the Trump affiliated blockchain firm, is now deploying its USD1 stablecoin (market cap $4 billion) natively on the Canton Network.
